answer: About 1 second of fixed planning and offset-commit overhead per micro-batch cycle on a typical cluster (pa_pattern_batch_or_stream_intermediate.md, L345). At a 2 s trigger, about half the time (roughly 50%) goes to that overhead. At a 100 ms trigger, almost all of the time goes to it (about 90% or more, since 1 s of overhead dwarfs the 100 ms cycle), which is why micro-batch stops paying below about 1 s.
